items.problem: Step 3 applies "the value with the shake offset and the shake rotation added", but the spec defines only a base position, not a base rotation. For a 2D camera whose rotation is r0 ≠ 0 when it is attached, one implementation sets the rotation to the shake rotation (so r0 is overwritten with 0 on the first frame), and another adds the shake rotation to r0. What is drawn differs from the first frame after `attach_camera`, even without a shake. camera-core.md:69 says only position and zoom are taken at attach
